newsitem.title: USA: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu merges with Kwan Wong Tan.
newsitem.headline: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu merges with Kwan Wong Tan.

text.p: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu and Kwan Wong Tan & Fong, two professional service firms, said Friday they have merged their practices.
The new combined firm, which is the largest certified public accounting practice in Hong Kong, will operate under the name Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu, they said. It will have about 2,000 employees.

"The merger is being driven by our need to expand our capabilities and strengthen our presence in Hong Kong and China in response to the changing needs of our local and multinational clients," Chairman Robert Kwan said in a statement.

"By combining the international resources and expertise of Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu and the local experience and business network of Kwan Wong Tan & Fong, we provide our clients with the best of both worlds," he said.
Deloitte & Touche LLP is the U.S. practice of the global partnership firm of Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu.
